turns.question: How many degrees Celsius warmer was Istanbul than Amsterdam on average in daily temperature on 1 and 2 October 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no temperature metric, so I cannot give Istanbul's and Amsterdam's average daily temperatures for 1 and 2 October 2026. None of the available metrics (revenue, orders, leads, bookings, ad spend, returns, hiring or site-session metrics) measures weather, so there is no closest metric to offer.
